purpose: Issue exactly one execution command for the already loaded, hash-identified script in the matching design.
trigger: Use only after authorization, session, document, and loaded-script gates are satisfied.

inputs.name: loaded_script_identity
inputs.description: Exact loaded script identity, hash, session, and document binding.

inputs.name: current_design_identity
inputs.description: Active design identity and clean/baseline-copy entry state.

preconditions: Loaded script and current design identities match the accepted run.
Target session is authorized, idle, and free of a blocking dialog.

outputs.name: execution_event
outputs.description: One run identifier, launch time, script hash, session/document identity, and command observation.

outputs.name: launch_status
outputs.description: One of launched, rejected, or needs_manual_review; not a completion result.

postconditions: Exactly one execution event is observed and correlated with the loaded artifact.
No success, failure, save, or geometry measurement is inferred from launch alone.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the target window kept maximized unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI action or observation; it must not expand this contract into a workflow. Starts one run only; waiting and terminal classification belong to EX-10.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: An identity, authorization, or idle gate is false.
failure_modes.detection: A gate fails immediately before Run.

failure_modes.condition: It is unclear whether one execution command was accepted.
failure_modes.detection: UI response or run ID cannot be correlated.
failure_modes.safe_state: Do not issue another Run command.

recovery.action: Correct exactly the failed gate and return to a clean loaded-script state.
Preserve the observation and return needs_manual_review.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Exactly one execution event is observed and correlated with the loaded artifact.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
